title: Browser
intro: Create a tab and open a URL. Click the page to navigate, or enable pointing to annotate an element.
text: Text to enter in the focused field
added: Annotation and screenshot added to the draft. Review them, then send your message.
draftUnavailable: Could not add to this conversation’s draft. Check that it is writable.
unavailable: Operation failed. Check the URL, administrator access and isolated browser configuration. Only public HTTP(S) sites are allowed.
privacy: Temporary remote session, separate from your browser. Input fields are masked in screenshots. Pages and annotations reach the agent only after you send the message.
frame: Embedded frame: the marker identifies the frame, not its contents
